entries.en: Girllll, where'd you get those ladies done?
Oh, there's a ripper in Japantown. Do you for a smile.
entries.ro: Ă, e un ripper în Japantown. Îți face gratis pe un zâmbet.

entries.en: Nah, come on. No such thing as a free lunch – and a smile won't get you none, either.
entries.ro: Nah, hai, nimic nu e pe degeaba. Și zâmbetul nu-ți dă nimic, nici el.

entries.en: Hahah! Actually thought a smile was all I gave him?
entries.ro: Hahah! Chiar credeai că i-am dat doar un zâmbet?

entries.en: Well, the input won't be happy...
entries.ro: Păi, input-ul n-o să fie fericit...

entries.en: It's not like he's happy now.
